usedFor: AgencyAnalytics is where an agency keeps clients and reporting users; Zoom runs the webinars. A “New Client” in AgencyAnalytics can sign that client up for a webinar through “Register Attendee for Webinar”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in AgencyAnalytics, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A newly created client is the natural person to invite to an onboarding or reporting webinar. “New User” also fits when you want each added login registered.

watchOut: “New Client” polls your AgencyAnalytics account, so registration follows a little after the client is created. You also need to pick a specific webinar in “Register Attendee for Webinar”.
